summary: Every course must be taken for a letter grade, except AMSTUD 99 and the honors workshops, which are only offered S/NC, and the audit counts your courses toward the 62 units the major needs. On the honors path only 2 of the honors units (AMSTUD 198, 199A, 199B, 250) count toward the 62, in place of the Senior Colloquium. A course counts for one requirement only; AMSTUD 160 is both the gateway seminar and the WIM course. You check by hand the non-literary arts course, the five-course thematic concentration with its research seminar, the writing sample, the senior survey, and for honors the thesis and the 3.5 major GPA.

program.why: Grading: "Completion of the major normally requires 14 courses (totaling at least 62 units), all of which must be taken for a letter grade (with the exception of AMSTUD 99: Senior Colloquium and the Honors Workshop sequence, which are only offered S/NC)." The S/NC-only courses still count.

totals.why: "Honors students are exempt from the Senior Colloquium and may instead use two units of the required honors workshop units (e.g., from 199A and 199B) to replace the 2-unit Senior Colloquium. The additional 8-13 thesis units do not count toward major course and unit minimums."

ePuS9p9i.why: The gateway seminar AMSTUD 160 is core coursework; its WIM designation is the separate rule in the Writing in the Major block, so this rule does not need to share.

QFHWxpFE.why: "Majors must complete three courses in history, politics, and society, including at least two of the three courses from the American History survey sequence (i.e. 150A, 150B, 150C)." At least two means the third survey course can be the third course. Other alternatives are discussed with the program advisor and moved in by hand.

syXIDD9C.why: "Majors must design a Thematic Concentration of at least five courses with the help of faculty advisors ... Thematic Concentrations should be approved", "All majors must take at least one upper-level seminar requiring a substantial research project within their Thematic Concentration." and "To graduate, all majors must submit a representative writing sample to American Studies by spring of senior year".

Writing sample submitted to American Studies by spring of senior year

gYpJ5GcN.why: "Qualified majors may apply to pursue an honors thesis in their senior year for 10-15 units total, including: 3 units from required pre-honors and honors workshops (AMSTUD 198, 199A, and 199B) Plus 7-12 units of AMSTUD 250: Senior Research". The three workshops carry one unit each, so the 10 units leave at least 7 for AMSTUD 250. One rule, so this path counts the same as the one-course colloquium path.

XFL6l9cf.why: Inside the opt-in Honors section these are requirements: "Students pursuing honors must enroll in ... AMSTUD 198 ... AMSTUD 199A and AMSTUD 199B ... They must also enroll in AMSTUD 250 Senior Research during their senior year. The total units between AMSTUD 198, AMSTUD 199A and B, and AMSTUD 250 should equal 10-15." and "To graduate with honors, American Studies majors must complete a senior thesis and have an overall grade point average of at least 3.5 in the major or demonstrated academic competence."
